description: Controlled research-paper validation with synthetic suspicious documents. Verbatim copies and hand-written paraphrases of genuine body passages are planted in synthetic documents; negative controls compare against the wrong source. Production detection code, thresholds, alpha values, and model configuration were NOT modified. Synthetic results do NOT establish real-world plagiarism accuracy.

methodology.sourceSelection: Papers with confidently detected reference sections and the highest counts of clean (letter-dense, multi-sentence) body paragraphs.
methodology.referenceStripping: stripCanonicalReferences() applied in-memory; canonical files unchanged.
